info.title: Doce Encanto Core API
info.description: Session-base API. Authenticate with POST /api/v1/auth/login. Every request that changes state must send the X-Requested-With header. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable "code" property,

post.summary: Log in and start a session (204 + SESSION cookie); 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS on failure

get.summary: Deliveries, sales, cash received and receivables for the home screen
Return the authenticated user; 401 UNAUTHENTICATED when there is no valid session

code.description: Stable error code; the UI text is chosen from it.
